inspector.title: Cavernous nerves: original dissection photographs
inspector.modality: Published cadaveric source photographs and static navigation figure
inspector.caption: Inspect the original surgical views of cranial nerves III, IV, V and VI and their cavernous relationships. Source annotations and perspective are retained. The viewer discloses wording discrepancies in figures 2 and 3. These altered cadaveric exposures are separate from the MRI case and atlas references.
